trial_court: MAT Suit No. 200 of 2011, Additional District Judge, 5th Court, Barasat, 24-Parganas (North)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: husband — revisional application filed by husband
parties.respondent_defendant: wife — revisional application filed by wife

facts_of_case: Wife initiated MAT Suit No. 200 of 2011 seeking dissolution of marriage. Husband entered appearance and is contesting the matter. During pendency of the Matrimonial Suit, wife took out an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act and prayed for alimony pendente lite.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking alimony to prove their income and expenses.
legal_principles.held: There is no specific document to show wife's income. There is no document to show that she is collecting Rs. 10,000/- per month from any person, her alleged tenant.

legal_principles.principle: The court may enhance or reduce alimony pendente lite based on the changed circumstances.
legal_principles.held: It may be enhanced. It may be reduced.

outcome.final_order: Order impugned may be interfered with and set aside; alternatively the alimony pendente lite may be reduced.
